feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 September 2026 10:01pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 23 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure to the southwest of Iceland and high pressure over the British Isles as a weak warm front approaches from the west.


##Wind##

Variable 3 or less, becoming south or southeast 3 or 4 overnight, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning and occasionally 6 in the west. Veering southerly 5 or 6 more generally in the afternoon, although force 4 in the east at times.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building mainly moderate tomorrow afternoon but remaining slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5 but force 6 in central sea areas, veering west or northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Friday, backing southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle becoming isolated later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
